## Checklists

Westman Naturalists have produced a bird checklist for Brandon and area, using eBird data and
expertise from a number of Westman Naturalists members. This version for
Brandon Riverbank Inc. highlights birds that are likely to be seen around the
Discovery Centre. The checklist can be [downloaded here](resources/Brandon Riverbank Bird Checklist.pdf).
